mapper.select: SELECT DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, DETAIL.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO_TAIL AS detailSubjectNo, DETAIL.DETAIL_SUBNAME_TAIL AS detailSubjectName, DETAIL.CD_FLAG AS cdFlag, DETAIL.CCY AS ccy, DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT AS happenAmt, DETAIL.B_CCY AS bCcy, DETAIL.B_HAPPEN_AMT AS bHappenAmt, DETAIL.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS happenNumber FROM TRD_VOUCH_DEAL_DETAIL DETAIL WHERE DETAIL.TRADE_ID = #{seqno}

select TRADE_ID as seqno, BOOK_DATE as bookDate, BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, BOOK_ID as bookId, OFFSET_FLAG AS offsetFlag, RECORD_TYPE AS recordType, BUSI_ID as busiId, BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE as finprodType, BUSI_TYPE as busiType, BOOK_REMARK AS bookRemark, P_TRADE_ID AS cashId, ACCOUNT_ORDER AS accountOrder, INV_AIM as invAim from TRD_VOUCH_DEAL where TRADE_ID=#{seqno}
